caption: Nico on the boardwalk at golden hour, a Sun Disc at his shoulder and the whole city — with Dalia's first job on the HUD — spread out in front of him.
name: 1-cover.jpg
staging: On foot at the boardwalk's east end, camera low behind his shoulder looking north-west across the shore road into downtown, so the disc, the café and the tower blocks share one frame.

caption: Driving the shore road in traffic as the streetlights come on, the speedometer and minimap live on the HUD.
name: 2-drive.jpg
staging: Player at the wheel of a sedan in the eastbound lane of the shore road at moderate speed, chase camera behind and above, traffic ahead in the same lane.

caption: Three stars up: Sunfall PD cruisers with strobing light bars crowd the stolen Solstice GT along the shore road while the HUD orders Nico to lose the heat.
name: 3-chase.jpg
staging: Player driving the amber GT eastbound at speed, three cruisers posed in pursuit behind and beside, wanted level set to three stars so the stars, the bust meter and the minimap's flashing police all read at a glance.

caption: The First Light Run in progress: the cooler in the car, Dockside Cold Storage ahead, its beacon up and the delivery clock running on the HUD.
name: 4-mission.jpg
staging: Player driving toward the warehouse's south face on the final approach, mission phase set to the delivery leg with 74 seconds on the timer and the objective beacon standing on the destination.
